eeg_normalization_note: transductive: each subject's own label-free EEG statistics

metric_definitions.r: Pearson correlation per trial per axis; mean over trials, then over axes, then subjects
metric_definitions.r2: 1 - SS_res / SS_tot per trial per axis (SS_tot around the trial mean); same aggregation
metric_definitions.rmse: root mean squared error per trial per axis (target units); same aggregation
metric_definitions.nrmse: RMSE / (max - min of the true signal) per trial per axis; same aggregation
metric_definitions.pooled_r: SECONDARY, labeled: Pearson r over all samples of all trials concatenated, per axis, then mean over axes; inflated by trial-to-trial stereotypy
